Subject: Vendor onboarding: tax attestation, bank-letter alternatives, and PO timing

Hi Ana / Finance team,

Thanks for starting the onboarding process with Redwood Inference. To move Lumen Labs into our vendor system and issue the PO, we need the following items to satisfy our tax and payment onboarding checks:

- Completed W-9 (US entities) or W-8BEN-E (non-US entities) with an authorized signature.
- One of the following for tax ID verification: a copy of the IRS notice (147C), a notarized bank letter on bank letterhead, or completion of KBA (knowledge-based authentication) via our third-party vendor.
- If your EIN/name on the W-9 doesn't match your company bank records, please include an explanatory bank letter or certificate of formation showing the DBA.

What will speed this up: send signed PDFs directly (not photos) and, if possible, upload them to the secure DocuSign envelope we set up (link below). If you prefer SFTP, tell me and I’ll share credentials.

Timeline: once verified by Procurement + Finance, we typically issue a PO within 2 business days. If any of the items above require legal review (e.g., cross-border withholding or treaty claims), that may add time — we’ll flag it.

DocuSign upload link: https://docusign.com/XYZ123
PO target (once docs verified): PO-987654 (we’ll confirm in a follow-up).

Attachments we accept: PDF W-9/W-8BEN-E, bank-letter.pdf, 147C_notice.pdf.

Let me know if remote notarization is okay for your bank letter or if you need alternate KBA steps.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Procurement Associate
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai

---
Note: Please avoid sending SSNs over email. Use redacted copies for W-9 where appropriate.

Hi Ana — thanks for the quick reply and for attaching the W-9. A few clarifications from Procurement/Finance operations so we can avoid a hold: 

- Remote-notarized bank letters are acceptable provided the letter includes: bank letterhead, account holder name, routing/account last 4 digits, and is notarized with a date. We will ask Finance to validate the notary cert if needed.

- DBA mismatch: that alone doesn't always block a PO. If the W-9 name and bank account name differ, Finance requires either (a) an explanation letter on company letterhead showing DBA usage, or (b) a certified formation document + bank letter confirming the linkage.

- If you prefer to avoid manual bank-letter handling, we can run KBA verification. That requires a vendor-authorized flow and completion by an owner-level signatory; it typically completes the same day but does involve a third-party identity check. Let us know if you want to run KBA and we’ll send the secure link.

- Upload options: DocuSign envelope (recommended) or our secure SFTP. For DocuSign, please confirm the email used to sign documents; I’ll re-send the envelope if needed.

Next steps once we have the signed W-9 + bank letter or KBA cleared: Finance will confirm tax-ID verification and then Procurement will finalize and issue PO-987654 within 1–2 business days. If everything lands today we can aim to have the PO by Friday.

Thanks — looping in Laura for payment-team visibility.

Monica Patel
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
